title: Cinematic daytime look: atmosphere, light balance, grade, ground wear, render scale + TAA

items.name: Aerial perspective: shared sky/fog haze color, blue-gray away from sun, warm forward-scatter lobe, Rayleigh extinction, day haze floor
White veil: extinction capped at 0.00019 (was 0.0007 at sunset/night), Mie in-scatter clamped
items.note: Fog part done. The remaining white towers at dusk are far-LOD buildings that show as flat pale boxes (city-look facade far material), not fog.

items.name: Sun-to-shade balance by day (hemisphere x0.62, PMREM x0.78, sun x1.14), fades out at low sun
items.note: Visible but subtle; game.look tunables. A stronger variant (0.45/0.6/1.25) also looked nearly identical (tune_house_*.png).

items.name: Neutral day grade (ref_51): light warm highlights, faint teal shadows, toe, vignette, sharpen per preset
Ground wear: macro patches, mottling, asphalt stains, tar, hairline cracks, lighter sun-bleached asphalt, worn paint, rough dry sand
Render scale (composer only) with GPU-bound frame-time governor and hysteresis
items.note: Seen holding scale 1 on CPU-bound headless frames, and at 0.8 under the first frame-time-only rule; not seen on the user's Mac.

items.name: TAA (jitter, depth reprojection, variance clip, Catmull-Rom history), auto mode below scale 1
items.note: Stills only; no motion or ghosting test. Softer than SMAA on swaying palms (no motion vectors).

items.name: GTAO off in every preset; auto-pick starts on high
Sun hot spot on sand: dry-sand roughness floor 0.93, HDR capped at 10 before bloom
Black trees at golden hour: sky fill no longer cut at low sun
items.note: Vegetation shading (translucency, wrap) belongs to the vegetation track.

items.name: Wet SSR, probe GI, haze lit by local lights (VFX_NOTES #1-3, #12)

postCost.method: post chain only, rendered 20x between 1-pixel readbacks, 1920x1080, South Beach (src/render/.lookab.mjs)
postCost.taaPathFullResMs_firstVersion: 3.0 to 4.8 (9-tap TAA at scale 1; since cut to a 4-tap cross and runs only below scale 1)
